topics.headline: US CPI set to decelerate in June, breaking joint-acceleration condition
topics.summary: Both Eurostat's flash HICP (2.8%, down from 3.2%) and multiple US CPI nowcasts/forecasts point to a June deceleration as the Middle East-driven energy spike reverses, making it very unlikely both US and Eurozone inflation rise simultaneously versus May.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle lows, but hikes odds and CCC stress build
topics.summary: The ICE BofA HY OAS sits around 2.67-2.70%, well below its 20-year average, even as markets price rising odds of a Fed rate hike and CCC-vs-single-B spread dispersion widens sharply, hinting that broad spreads could drift modestly wider without a fundamental shock.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs post third straight inflow day after eight-week outflow streak
topics.summary: BTC ETFs pulled in about $282M for the week of July 7-11, snapping eight weeks of outflows totaling $9.46B, but daily flows remain choppy (+$90M July 10) and analysts call it a cautious re-entry, not a confirmed reversal, with June CPI on July 14 seen as the key catalyst.

topics.headline: VIX spot at 15 sits below its 17.10 3-month average
topics.summary: Spot VIX has dropped to ~15, well under its trailing 3-month average of 17.10, as Iran de-escalation talks resume; but elevated SKEW (150) and VIX1Y (23) show hedgers still paying up for tail risk, and the July 17 Iran oil sanctions deadline could reignite a spike within the 30-day window.

topics.headline: Hyperscaler power deals now near-monthly; base rate strongly favors YES
topics.summary: With Chevron-Microsoft's 2.67GW Kilby PPA, Meta's 6.6GW nuclear commitments, and GE Vernova's order book full through 2029-2031, gigawatt-scale power deals are being announced on a roughly monthly cadence, making another major announcement within 30 days highly likely.
